text:
1. 2. 2. 

Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi yena anuppanno vā vyāpādo uppajjati, uppanno vā vyāpādo bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati, yathayidaṃ bhikkhave paṭighanimittaṃ paṭighanimittaṃ bhikkhave ayoniso manasi karoto anuppanno ceva vyāpādo uppajjati, uppanno va vyāpādo bhiyyobhāvāya veppulāya saṃvattatīti.
